+"""Request handlers."""
+
+import hashlib
+import hmac
+
+from app.config import get_setting
+from app.services import users
+
+
+def handle_verify_webhook(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    secret = get_setting("WEBHOOK_SECRET")
+    if not secret:
+        return 503, {"error": "not configured"}
+
+    body = params.get("body")
+    signature = params.get("signature")
+    if not isinstance(body, str) or not isinstance(signature, str):
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+
+    expected = hmac.new(secret.encode("utf-8"), body.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
+    try:
+        provided = signature.lower().encode("ascii")
+    except UnicodeEncodeError:
+        return 401, {"error": "bad signature"}
+    if hmac.compare_digest(expected.encode("ascii"), provided):
+        return 200, {"verified": True}
+    return 401, {"error": "bad signature"}
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user

cd /repo && cat > /tmp/verify_webhook.py <<'EOF'
import hashlib
import hmac
import os
import sys

# Case 1: secret missing
for k in ("WEBHOOK_SECRET",):
    os.environ.pop(k, None)
from app.api.handlers import handle_verify_webhook

assert handle_verify_webhook({"body": "x", "signature": "y"}) == (503, {"error": "not configured"}), "missing secret"
os.environ["WEBHOOK_SECRET"] = ""
assert handle_verify_webhook({"body": "x", "signature": "y"}) == (503, {"error": "not configured"}), "empty secret"

os.environ["WEBHOOK_SECRET"] = "s3cr3t"
body = "hello world"
sig = hmac.new(b"s3cr3t", body.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

# valid lowercase
assert handle_verify_webhook({"body": body, "signature": sig}) == (200, {"verified": True}), "valid lower"
# valid uppercase (case-insensitive)
assert handle_verify_webhook({"body": body, "signature": sig.upper()}) == (200, {"verified": True}), "valid upper"
# mixed case
assert handle_verify_webhook({"body": body, "signature": sig[:8].upper() + sig[8:]}) == (200, {"verified": True}), "mixed case"
# wrong signature
assert handle_verify_webhook({"body": body, "signature": "0" * 64}) == (401, {"error": "bad signature"}), "wrong sig"
# non-ascii signature
assert handle_verify_webhook({"body": body, "signature": "é" * 64}) == (401, {"error": "bad signature"}), "non-ascii sig"
# missing body
assert handle_verify_webhook({"signature": sig}) == (400, {"error": "invalid request"}), "missing body"
# missing signature
assert handle_verify_webhook({"body": body}) == (400, {"error": "invalid request"}), "missing sig"
# non-string body
assert handle_verify_webhook({"body": 123, "signature": sig}) == (400, {"error": "invalid request"}), "int body"
# non-string signature
assert handle_verify_webhook({"body": body, "signature": 123}) == (400, {"error": "invalid request"}), "int sig"
# None values
assert handle_verify_webhook({"body": None, "signature": None}) == (400, {"error": "invalid request"}), "none"
# non-ascii body still works (utf-8)
body2 = "café ☕"
sig2 = hmac.new(b"s3cr3t", body2.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
assert handle_verify_webhook({"body": body2, "signature": sig2}) == (200, {"verified": True}), "utf8 body"
# existing handler unaffected
assert handle_verify_webhook({"body": body, "signature": sig}) == (200, {"verified": True})
from app.api.handlers import handle_get_user
assert handle_get_user({"id": "1"})[0] == 200
assert handle_get_user({"id": "abc"})[0] == 400

print("ALL CHECKS PASSED")
